about.headline: About
about.body:
I'm a Robotics Engineering student at UC Santa Cruz (class of ’28). I like closing the loop between software and hardware — vision systems that drive motors, mechanisms that survive outdoors, and embedded UIs that have to work on a real car, not just a desk.

Lately that looks like a pan-tilt tracking turret, a fog-collector door mechanism, and a DIY OBD turbo gauge for my Integra. Outside of builds I tutor, and I'm an Eagle Scout.

home.supporting: Robots and mechanisms — designed, built, and tuned until they work.
